reviewedBy: The implementing agent (Claude Sonnet 5.5) reviewed its own work. No cold reviewer and no human has reviewed these screens.
method: Branch feat/analytics-site-data-settings at bd99964, 2026-10-06. Walked the site report (/sites), data quality (/data) and settings (/settings, signed out) on a local dev server reading production, at 1440x900 and 375x812: production state, populated state with invented Cloudflare and click figures, the Writing and Photography sections, 30 days, and simulated problems (late refresh, an open incident, two incomplete days); 90 days was only smoke-tested by request. Opened the captures and fixed what they showed: a clipped impact table on a phone, card text overflow at 200 percent text, link targets under 44 px, a global .field and .chip class colliding with the new pages, a void in the signed-out settings layout, a clipped Latest column in the delivery evidence table at 1440, record-form fields under 44 px or missing a focus ring or overflowing at 200 percent in the report-intelligence panel now mounted on the site report. Copy rules changed after review: a change is a percentage only when both periods have at least 20, otherwise the two counts are stated (4 against 2, not up 100 percent); one Today so far line for link clicks sits apart from every total. Gates run, and forced to fail once per width: overflow, 44 px targets, keyboard tab order and focus ring, ArrowRight on every scroll region, text at 200 percent. Home links to the data page anchors were followed and resolve. The owner views (settings; the site report in its record-only state) were rendered from throwaway harness routes (deleted, never committed) that mounted the real page components with invented data and stubbed endpoints: they prove layout only, and do not exercise the load functions, the auth check, the saved-view actions or the snapshot lookup; no shipped auth code was changed. Signed-out POSTs to the new actions were refused with a redirect to sign-in. Not covered: the real signed-in /settings and /sites (loads, saved-view actions, reporting settings, email delivery and the record form against real endpoints), the delivery counts on /data (owner only), real Cloudflare and PostHog figures, how the data status reads in production, the clean /data and /settings addresses on the real host and the report-host variant of the analytics preferences card, forced colors and increased contrast, Safari or a physical device, and a cold reviewer.
